title: Fivefold Akam Love: The First Stage of Physical Manifestations
paragraphs: While looking at the physical manifestations proper to the fivefold Akam love, it seems that the Meyppāṭṭiyal section of Tolkāppiyam may have inspired and aided the great bard Kampar. While describing the scene of the first meeting between Cītā who was standing on the terrace of the palace at Mitilai and Rāma who was ambling along the streets accompanied by the sage Viswamitrā, Kampar states:
The Lord looked at her, which she also reciprocated.
I must add a further gleam to Kampar’s imagination:
The Lord looked at her Which she also reciprocated,
Which the sage, an absolute renunciate, also noticed.
Encounter belongs usually to the warfield. But here it is the arena of love’s union.
In the lanes or gardens wearing a deserted look, The flower of a girl and the tiger of a young man run into. They are mature enough to understand the language of the eyes.
As their four eyes exchange their glances - Beads of perspiration appear on the forehead of this woman fit for poetry.
Her head drooped weighs down by abundant shyness. Whereas the man doesn’t fail to drop his hints.
That queen of beauty grasps his intension - immediately. How eager she is to converse with him!
Here is the picture of this encounter as it constitutes the first phase of the love career of the Akam hero and heroine:

The states of mind that there aptly manifest As the hero and the heroine are drawn by passion In their clandestine pre-marital course are: Her receptive posture as the hero’s passionate eyes fall on her, Her forehead wearing beads of sweating, Her coyness concealing her inward longing and delight And her keeping off from others, Her heart having been lost to him.
